question: Why does `accumulate(w.begin(), w.end(), 0)` give a wrong total here even though `total` is returned as a long long?
options: The initial value 0 is an int, so every addition is done in int and overflows silently
accumulate only reads the first half of the vector
Returning a long long from a function truncates it to int
The vector must be sorted before it is summed
why: accumulate uses the type of its initial value as the accumulator type. 0LL makes every partial sum a long long; the return type cannot repair an overflow that already happened.
